name: @penguinharness/skillweaver-rsi-toolkit
description: The SkillWeaver RSI Toolkit: SkillWeaver (Zheng et al., 2025, https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.07079), run the way the paper does — the agent explores a website on its own, proposes skills worth having, practises them, and hones the successful ones into reusable, tested API scripts kept in a skill library that later web tasks call. Self-contained: it creates the Target's skill library, runs the practice loop, evaluates its own cells and writes the Evaluation Center's scoreboard.
